name: Camurus AB (publ)
summary: Camurus AB (publ), a biopharmaceutical company, develops and commercializes medicines for severe and chronic diseases in Europe, Africa, the Middle East, North America, and Asia. The company offers Buvidal, a buprenorphine injection for the treatment of opioid dependence and chronic pain; and Brixadi to treat opioid use disorder.
